verdict: Brown-Forman's sales slipped 1% to $911M as the end of the Korbel relationship and weaker tequila sales outweighed a 20% jump in ready-to-drink brands, but lower postretirement costs still lifted net income 3% to $176M.

segments.name: Whiskey
segments.note: Jack Daniel's Tennessee Whiskey and family, Woodford Reserve and Old Forester — flat YoY and 72% of all sales. Growth from the Jack Daniel's Tennessee Blackberry launch offset declines in Tennessee Honey and Gentleman Jack.

segments.name: Ready-to-Drink
segments.note: Pre-mixed drinks — up 20%, led by New Mix (up 48%) on strong demand in Mexico and its U.S. launch, plus Jack Daniel's ready-to-drink brands (up 6%).

segments.name: Tequila
segments.note: Herradura (down 17%) and el Jimador (down 10%) — down 12% on lower U.S. volumes and lower pricing in Mexico.

segments.name: Rest of portfolio
segments.note: Diplomático rum, Gin Mare and other brands — down 35%, driven by the end of the Korbel sparkling-wine relationship.

segments.name: Non-branded and bulk
segments.note: Used barrels, contract bottling and bulk whiskey — down 61% on lower used-barrel sales. A tiny slice of revenue.

opex.name: Advertising expenses
opex.note: Advertising the brands — down 5% on the timing of Jack Daniel's spending.

opex.name: Selling, general and administrative expenses
opex.note: Selling and running the company — up 4%, including costs of targeted organizational realignments.

otherDetail: Other operating income of $2M, less $1M of non-operating postretirement expense and $22M of net interest expense — a net $21M cost.

takeaways.title: Ready-to-drink is the growth engine
takeaways.text: Ready-to-drink sales rose 20% to $154M, led by New Mix, up 48% on strong demand in Mexico and its U.S. launch — enough to offset much of the weakness elsewhere.

takeaways.title: Whiskey still pays the bills
takeaways.text: Whiskey was flat at $658M — 72% of sales. The Jack Daniel's Tennessee Blackberry launch and flat Tennessee Whiskey offset declines in Tennessee Honey (-10%) and Gentleman Jack (-16%).

takeaways.title: Emerging markets carried the map
takeaways.text: Emerging-market sales rose 11% (Mexico +26% on New Mix), while the United States fell 3% and Developed International fell 6% on weaker Jack Daniel's volumes in Germany, France and Spain.

footerNote: Brown-Forman reports operating income of $252M, which includes $2M of other operating income (net); this page groups that $2M with the items below operating income so the expense lines stay positive, giving a $250M operating step. Product-category sales are from the Q1 FY27 Form 10-Q; category growth rates are the release's reported figures.
